## Summary
The durable **run model** (spec §12.4) as a new pure, dependency-injected package **`@rhema/orchestrator`**, with thin adapters in **apps/api** (run creation + the internal run API) and **apps/worker** (`run.start/resume/cancel/reap` consumers + reaper). Matches the chain's pattern — a fully unit-testable DI core, live client binding (pg-boss / Redis / GKE / JWT) deferred to the deploy. Stacked on P0.07 (egress-proxy).

**All 8 acceptance criteria proven deterministically** over PGlite (real Postgres in WASM, real `@rhema/db` migrations) + `FakeEngine` (which replays through the real event mapper). Green gate: 81 build/lint/typecheck tasks; **591 tests** (+109).

## What changed
- **`packages/orchestrator`** (new): state-machine, run-creation, locks + admission, provision + resolver, internal run API, reaper, phase loop, completion oracle, project-state function, the §12.3 capability table, retry classes, reactions (back-edge / pause / hook-control), and DI seams (clock/ids/tx/queue/heartbeat/token/ledger/event-writer) + a PGlite test harness.
- **`packages/db`**: migration `0007_run_orchestration.sql` (additive) + Drizzle parity — `run_idempotency`, `projects.active_writer_run_id`, richer `proxy_allowlists` (endpoints/models/url_policy/cap) + `proxy_credentials` resolution columns, `runs.resume_count`.
- **apps/api**: `createRunRoutes` — `POST /projects/:id/runs` + the token-authed internal run API.
- **apps/worker**: `run.*` handlers + `gate:<id>` type registration (scheduling is P0.10's).
- **DEFERRALS**: `D-P0.07-3` → **DONE**; added `D-P0.08-1..4`.

## Design decisions
- **Every transition is a guarded CAS paired with its `run.state_changed` event in one transaction** (REQ-DATA-33) — atomicity proven with a forced-rollback test, not just "events exist".
- **Attempt fencing** on every internal call (`< current_attempt` → `409 stale_task`); the proxy credential is **rotated per attempt and revoked at every terminal state** (REQ-SPEC-11), with an `expires_at` backstop.
- **The proxy is the meter of record**; the orchestrator supplies inputs (rate table version, cap, attribution) and couples `hold/debit/release/refund` through an injected `HoldLedger` (P0.11 owns the real ledger) — no ledger rows written here.
- Boundaries to adjacent tickets kept clean via interfaces: event store/SSE → **P0.08b** (`EventWriter`), gate resolution/overlays → **P0.10** (we open gates + register the `gate:<id>` type only), harvest/delivery → **P0.09**, ledger internals → **P0.11**.

## Verification
- Unit + integration in-process over PGlite + FakeEngine + fakes; the AC1 lifecycle traversal drives the real mapper end-to-end; REQ-DATA-33 atomicity via a SQL-backed event writer + rollback.
- Two independent fresh-context reviews (design critique + spec gap analysis) ran against the diff; **every finding was closed** (writer-lock release, credential rotation/terminal-revocation, hold-release-on-cancel, `cancelling→cancelled`, CAS transitions, admission advisory lock, back-edge counting, REQ-ARCH-32 pause, per-step debit).
- No live runtime surface pre-deploy (GKE/pg-boss/Redis/proxy binding is `D-P0.08-1`, matching `D-P0.07-1`); live end-to-end is P0.15.
